paper_title: How Knowledge Popularity Influences and Enhances LLM Knowledge Boundary   Perception
caption: The QA performance, confidence, and alignment of Qwen2 under different question popularity.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
The diagram illustrates the changes in accuracy, confidence, and alignment of Qwen2-7B on movies in relation to question popularity. 

The X-axis is labeled "Question Popularity," with a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 55, and is marked at intervals of 5. The Y-axis is labeled "Values," also on a linear scale, spanning from 0.0 to 1.0, with markings at intervals of 0.2. 

The graph features three distinct lines. 
The blue line represents "Accuracy," marked with circular data points and a solid line style. It begins at approximately 0.13 when the question popularity is 15 and increases to around 0.86 at a question popularity of 55. Notably, there is a sharp rise between the popularity levels of 20 and 25. 
The green line signifies "Confidence," denoted by triangular markers and a solid line. It starts at about 0.76 at a question popularity of 15 and reaches roughly 0.94 at a question popularity of 55, maintaining an upward trend throughout. 
The red line indicates "Alignment," represented by square markers and a solid line. It commences at approximately 0.44 when the question popularity is 15 and ascends to around 0.92 at a question popularity of 55, exhibiting a consistent increase.
model_annotations.German: The diagram illustrates the relationship between question popularity and three performance metrics for the Qwen2-7B model on movie-related questions: accuracy, confidence, and alignment. The x-axis represents question popularity, ranging from 15 to 55, with a linear scale and no units specified; tick labels are numerical and increase by 5 units. The y-axis represents values, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with a linear scale and no units specified; tick labels are numerical and increase by 0.2 units. The diagram features three lines: a blue line with circular markers representing accuracy, starting at approximately (15, 0.15) and ending at approximately (55, 0.85); a green line with triangular markers representing confidence, starting at approximately (15, 0.75) and ending at approximately (55, 0.95); and a red line with square markers representing alignment, starting at approximately (15, 0.4) and ending at approximately (55, 0.9). All lines exhibit an upward trend, with accuracy increasing steadily from a lower value to a higher value, confidence remaining relatively stable at a higher value with a slight increase, and alignment increasing steadily from a moderate value to a higher value.
